explanation: State-feedback controller balances pole (theta ~0.06 rad, well within 0.8) with tiny corrective force (~0.55 N, far below 40 N limit) but allows steady cart drift: starting at x=0.5, v=0.5 with light cart (0.5kg), heavy/long pole and high gravity at coarse dt=0.02, cart velocity grows to ~1.36 m/s and position drifts monotonically off the 2.4m track by step 95. Likely cause: controller gains stabilize angle but provide insufficient cart-position centering/damping for this plant, so cart_in_track is violated while pole remains upright.
